mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_m ( SEQ, EMP_NO, USER_NM, PROJ_CODE, PROJ_NAME, CRTDATE ) VALUES ( #{seq}, #{empNo}, #{userNm}, #{projCode}, #{projName}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO contract_d ( SEQ, CONT_DATE, MOVE_DATE, CONT_AMT, DEPOSIT_AMT, RENT_AMT, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_D, RES_TYPE, TRANS_TYPE, AREA, CRTDATE, ACCU, SOURCE, CHK_1, CHK_2, CHK_3, CHK_4, CHK_5 , CHK_REASON_1 , CHK_REASON_2 , CHK_REASON_3 , CHK_REASON_4 , CHK_REASON_5 ) VALUES ( #{seq}, #{contDate}, #{moveDate}, #{contAmt}, #{depositAmt}, #{rentAmt}, #{address}, #{addressD}, #{resType}, #{transType}, #{area}, NOW(), #{accu}, #{source}, #{chk1}, #{chk2}, #{chk3}, #{chk4}, #{chk5} , #{chkReason1} , #{chkReason2} , #{chkReason3} , #{chkReason4} , #{chkReason5} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.seq, m.emp_no, m.user_nm, m.proj_code, m.proj_name, m.appr_no, d.cont_date, d.move_date, d.cont_amt, d.deposit_amt, d.rent_amt, d.address, d.address_d, d.res_type, d.trans_type, d.area, d.crtdate, d.accu, d.source, d.chk_1, d.chk_2, d.chk_3, d.chk_4, d.chk_5, d.chk_reason_1, d.chk_reason_2, d.chk_reason_3, d.chk_reason_4, d.chk_reason_5 FROM contract_m m , contract_d d WHERE m.seq = d.seq and m.seq = #{seq}

SELECT m.seq, m.emp_no, m.user_nm, m.proj_code, m.proj_name, m.appr_no, d.cont_date, d.move_date, d.cont_amt, d.deposit_amt, d.rent_amt, d.address, d.address_d, d.res_type, d.trans_type, d.area, d.crtdate, d.accu, d.source, d.chk_1, d.chk_2, d.chk_3, d.chk_4, d.chk_5, d.chk_reason_1, d.chk_reason_2, d.chk_reason_3, d.chk_reason_4, d.chk_reason_5 FROM contract_m m , contract_d d , approval_m am WHERE m.appr_no = ( SELECT appr_no FROM contract_m WHERE seq = #{seq} ) AND am.appr_no = m.appr_no AND d.seq = m.seq

SELECT m.seq ,m.emp_no ,m.user_nm ,m.proj_code ,m.proj_name ,m.appr_no ,d.cont_date ,d.move_date ,d.cont_amt ,d.deposit_amt ,d.rent_amt ,d.address ,d.address_d ,d.res_type ,d.trans_type ,d.area ,d.crtdate ,d.accu ,d.source ,d.chk_1 ,d.chk_2 ,d.chk_3 ,d.chk_4 ,d.chk_5 ,d.chk_reason_1 ,d.chk_reason_2 ,d.chk_reason_3 ,d.chk_reason_4 ,d.chk_reason_5 FROM contract_m m , contract_d d WHERE m.seq = d.seq AND m.proj_code = #{proj_code}
SELECT ADDRESS as address, ADDRESS_D as addressD FROM contract_d

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT m.seq, m.emp_no, m.user_nm, m.proj_code, m.proj_name, m.appr_no, d.cont_date, d.move_date, d.cont_amt, d.deposit_amt, d.rent_amt, d.address, d.address_d, d.res_type, d.trans_type, d.area, d.crtdate, d.accu, d.source, d.chk_1, d.chk_2, d.chk_3, d.chk_4, d.chk_5, d.chk_reason_1, d.chk_reason_2, d.chk_reason_3, d.chk_reason_4, d.chk_reason_5, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.appr_no ORDER BY m.seq) AS rn FROM contract_m m , contract_d d , approval_m a1 where m.seq = d.seq AND m.appr_no = a1.appr_no ) sub WHERE rn = 1
SELECT appr_stat, appr_emp_no, appr_emp_nm, appr_date, appr_stat, reject FROM approval_m
SELECT appr_stat, appr_emp_no, appr_emp_nm, appr_date, appr_stat, reject FROM approval_m WHERE appr_no = #{appr_no}
mapper.update: UPDATE contract_d SET cont_date = #{cont_date}, move_date = #{move_date}, cont_amt = #{cont_amt}, deposit_amt = #{deposit_amt}, rent_amt = #{rent_amt}, address = #{address}, address_d = #{address_d}, res_type = #{res_type}, trans_type = #{trans_type}, area = #{area}, crtdate = #{crtdate}, accu = #{accu}, source = #{source}, chk_1 = #{chk_1}, chk_2 = #{chk_2}, chk_3 = #{chk_3}, chk_4 = #{chk_4}, chk_5 = #{chk_5}, chk_reason_1 = #{chk_reason_1}, chk_reason_2 = #{chk_reason_2}, chk_reason_3 = #{chk_reason_3}, chk_reason_4 = #{chk_reason_4}, chk_reason_5 = #{chk_reason_5} WHERE seq = #{seq};
